//: Turbo façade for geoai-bench. See python/geoai-core/package.json for the two rules: `cd` to the repository root first, and never reach a tool through node_modules/.bin.
name: @geoaiworkbench/bench

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && ruff check python/geoai-bench && ruff format --check python/geoai-bench
scripts.fmt: cd ../.. && ruff check --fix python/geoai-bench && ruff format python/geoai-bench

//cov: COVERAGE_FILE is not optional. turbo runs all three cov tasks concurrently in the same working directory, and coverage's default data file is the single path ./.coverage — so the three runs interleave writes to one SQLite file and each report ends up containing every package's numbers (observed: geoai-core's report listing all three packages, geoai-mcp's listing two). The numbers stay plausible, which is the dangerous part: nothing looks wrong, the merged total is just wrong. One data file per package is the fix; a per-package data_file in pyproject.toml would work too but is invisible at the point where the collision happens.
